title: tragacantha kuhistana
intro: Tragacantha kuhistana, commonly known as Persian thistle, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, and its health benefits are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha kuhistana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which contribute to its wound-healing and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
